**Risk flags:**  
- Single shareholder holds 58.25%

**Overview:**  
Unity Global Trading Sdn. Bhd. is a private limited retailer of textiles and *baju kurung* based in Selangor. The company was incorporated on 2018‑06‑15 and has a paid‑up share capital of RM 250,000. It is governed by five directors, with the largest shareholder owning 58.25% of the equity. Reported revenues are RM 5,130,131; RM 5,229,803; and RM 5,352,856 across three reporting periods, while net profit, audit opinion and current ratio are not disclosed. No legal cases are recorded.
